title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Expected to Announce Quarterly Sales of $91.79 Billion
text:
Wall Street brokerages expect Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report sales of $91.79 billion for the current quarter, according to Zacks . Ten analysts have issued estimates for Apple’s earnings, with the highest sales estimate coming in at $93.01 billion and the lowest estimate coming in at $90.80 billion. Apple reported sales of $88.29 billion in would suggest a positive year-over-year growth rate of 4%. The business is scheduled to report its next quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 7th.
On average, analysts expect that Apple will report full year sales of $278.16 billion for the current financial $265.60 billion to $287.42 billion. For the next fiscal year, analysts forecast that the company will post sales of $289.34 billion, $274.64 billion to $304.35 billion. Zacks Investment Research’s sales averages are an sell-side research analysts that cover Apple.
